mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate at 4.83% as of 2023-04-30
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1.4 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Residential construction at 1420.0 thousand units as of 2023-03-31
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in high-HOUST periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102.5 for two consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic slowdown, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 102.5 for two months, or the mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal persistent inflation and a hawkish monetary policy response, which compresses equity valuations via higher discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL > 302.0 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength, which supports corporate revenues and earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST > 1400.0 and RSAFS > 680000.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a labor market overheating that fuels wage inflation and forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200.0 and UNRATE < 3.5%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized, combined with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 305.0), signals a healthy economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 20235.0 and CPIAUCSL < 305.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
